claim.claim-text: 1. An electronic device (500) comprising:

2. The electronic device of claim 1, wherein, the content is displayed on a first layer, and the icon is displayed on a second layer, wherein the icon is movable on the display based on a touch input when the icon is in a floating state.

3. The electronic device of claim 1 or 2, wherein the memory (520) further stores instructions enabling the control circuit (510) to: in response to a second user input via the icon while ceasing the transmission of the data, retransmit the data associated with the content to the external device (1000).
4. The electronic device of claim 3, wherein the memory (520) further stores instructions enabling the control circuit (510) to:

based on the execution of the sharing function, establish, via the communication circuit (530), a wireless connection between the electronic device (500) and the external device (1000); and in response to a third input via the icon, release the wireless connection between the communication circuit (530) and the external device (1000).

5. The electronic device of claim 1, wherein the memory (520) further stores instructions enabling the control circuit (510) to: based on the content corresponding to a video, display, on the display (540), a control video for controlling playback of the content displayed on the display of the external device (1000) with displaying the content on a first layer and the icon on a second layer over the first layer, while the data associated with the content is transmitted to the external device.

6. The electronic device of claim 5, wherein the memory (520) further stores instructions enabling the control circuit (510) to: in response to a second input via the icon, stop displaying the control video and display the content with displaying the icon on the second layer.

7. The electronic device of claim 1, wherein the memory (520) further stores instructions enabling the control circuit (510) to: based on the user input via the icon, transmit a status image indicating a pause state of the sharing function to the external device, while continuing to display, on the display of the electronic device (500), the content on a first layer and the icon with changed form corresponding to the pause state on a second layer that is an upper layer over the first layer.
8. The electronic device (500) of claim 2, 5, or 7, wherein the memory (520) further stores instructions enabling the control circuit (510) to:

transmit audio data corresponding to the content with the data associated with the first layer including the content to the external device (1000); and in response to the user input via the icon, cease the transmission of the data associated with the content and the audio data.
9. A method of an electronic device (500) for controlling video sharing comprising:

displaying, on a display (540) of the electronic device (500), a content with an icon for controlling the display of the content; based on an execution of a sharing function between the electronic device (500) and an external device (1000), transmitting in a streaming mode, to the external device (1000), data associated with the content for simultaneously displaying on a display of the external device (1000), without transmitting data associated with the icon; and based on a user input via the icon, ceasing transmission of the data associated with the content and periodically transmitting a status image indicating a pause state of the sharing function to the external device, while continuing to display, on the display of the electronic device (500), the content and the icon.

10. The method of claim 9, further comprising: in response to a second user input via the icon while ceasing the transmission of the data, retransmitting the data associated with the content to the external device (1000).
11. The method of claim 10, further comprising:

based on the execution of the sharing function, establishing a wireless connection between the electronic device (500) and the external device (1000); and in response to a third input via the icon, releasing the wireless connection between the electronic device (500) and the external device (1000).

12. The method of claim 9, further comprising: based on the content corresponding to a video, displaying, on the display (540), a control video for controlling playback of the content displayed on the display of the external device (1000) with displaying the content on a first layer and the icon on a second layer, while the data associated with the content is transmitted to the external device.
13. The method of claim 12, further comprising: in response to a second input via the icon:
stopping displaying the control video; and displaying the content with displaying the icon on the second layer.
14. The method of claim 12, wherein the second layer is an upper layer over the first layer.
15. The method of claim 12, further comprising:

transmitting audio data corresponding to the content with the data associated with the first layer including the content to the external device (1000); and in response to the user input via the icon, ceasing the transmission of the data associated with the content and the audio data.
